input.preprocessing: Split raw EEG into independent 10s windows FIRST, then 004 bandpass 0.1-75Hz, notch 50Hz and resample 250->200Hz independently; identical train/public
input.amplitude_scale: per-channel RMS of demeaned samples fitted on training fold only, applied unchanged to validation/public

protocol.repeat_interpretation: paired descriptive fold sensitivity, not independent significance tests
protocol.stop_rule: If amplitude fixed-fold AUC is below control, stop direction; preregistered repeats still reported if run
protocol.cpu_budget_fallback: fixed folds first; repeated folds may be explicitly incomplete if excessive cost
